title: Version Changelog - 2026
body_markdown:
## ChatGPT Plugin v0.1.0[​](https://wiki.heptabase.com/changelog/changelog#chatgpt-plugin-v010)


*September 23, 2026*


- ChatGPT Plugin: Search, read, create, edit, and organize your knowledge in ChatGPT


- You can now preview Heptabase cards directly in ChatGPT and open them in Heptabase.
- Search and read cards, journals, images, PDFs, whiteboards, and tag databases.
- Create and edit notes, append to journals, update card properties, and add cards to whiteboards and existing tag databases.


## v1.112.0[​](https://wiki.heptabase.com/changelog/changelog#v11120)


*September 23, 2026*


- Whiteboard: Mini map


- Tag Database: Reorder options for select and multi-select properties


- Support GPT-6 Sol, GPT-6 Luna, and Claude Opus 5.5 models.

## v1.103.0[​](https://wiki.heptabase.com/changelog/changelog#v11030)


*August 14, 2026*


- AI Agent: Upgrade How You Read with AI Skills


- 中文版影片：用 AI Skills 升級你的閱讀方式


- You can now use the Break down book skill to turn a book or chapter into a paragraph-complete, citation-backed whiteboard.
- AI Agent can now create and update whiteboard connections, align objects, and create shortcuts to other whiteboards.
- Notes and journals created through the CLI are now marked as Created by AI by default; use` --no-created-by-ai` to opt out.
- Improve AI Agent performance while responses are streaming.
- Fix an issue where corrupted local transaction data could leave sync stuck in a reconnect loop on the web app.
- Fix an issue where whiteboard section titles could disappear after Zoom to Fit or from exported images.
- Fix an issue where block selections could lose focus in the editor.


## v1.102.0[​](https://wiki.heptabase.com/changelog/changelog#v11020)


*August 4, 2026*


- CLI (Skill): allow agents to read cards and tags through deep links
- You can now drag images directly into the AI chat composer.
- You can now zoom and pan images and Mermaid diagrams in the preview viewer.
- You can now resize whiteboard instances to a compact height.
- AI chat can now use your active view, including selected whiteboard objects and the current PDF page, as context.
- AI Agent runs now preserve partial output and let you retry when they fail.
- Improve AI Agent performance when listing cards, tags, and whiteboards.
- Improve AI Agent reliability when searching cards and editing database properties.
- Fix an issue where earlier chat messages could disappear.
- Fix an issue where Heptabase links could be treated as external URLs or web cards.
- Fix an issue where some web links failed to open when their preferred destination was unavailable.
- Fix an issue where dividers could disappear or leave no editable paragraph after keyboard navigation or shortcut insertion.
- Fix an issue where original URLs could change when pasted into the editor.
- Migrate the data schema to support new features. Please update your Heptabase desktop and mobile apps to the latest version, and refresh your web app to sync.


## v1.101.2[​](https://wiki.heptabase.com/changelog/changelog#v11012)


*July 28, 2026*


- You can now choose which AI models appear in model pickers from Settings.
- You can now open web links in a new tab, in the side panel, or in your default browser.
- Fix issues when Codex agents start Heptabase via CLI in sandbox.
- Fix an issue where some card links did not respond when clicked.
- Fix an issue where table controls did not work correctly.
- Fix an issue where an incorrect AI chat plan limit message briefly appeared when switching models with a connected ChatGPT plan.


## v1.101.1[​](https://wiki.heptabase.com/changelog/changelog#v11011)


*July 27, 2026*


- AI Agent - Use ChatGPT Codex inside Heptabase.


- The AI chat composer now shows whether your next message will use your ChatGPT plan, your own API key, or Heptabase AI credits, and lets you change it directly.
- Improve link navigation across chats and notes: links now open in the appropriate tab, honor Cmd/Ctrl-click to open a new tab, and open in the browser when using the web app.
- PDF cards on whiteboards no longer blur when you hover over them.
- Fix an issue where navigating back from a temporary tab could close the wrong tab or override newer navigation.
- Fix an issue where closing certain dropdown menus moved keyboard focus unexpectedly.


## Mobile app v1.37.4[​](https://wiki.heptabase.com/changelog/changelog#mobile-app-v1374)


*July 27, 2026*


- Fix an issue where some Android devices crashed unexpectedly.


## v1.100.1[​](https://wiki.heptabase.com/changelog/changelog#v11001)


*July 26, 2026*

## v1.100.0[​](https://wiki.heptabase.com/changelog/changelog#v11000)


*July 24, 2026*


- AI Agent: Support OpenRouter and open source models: DeepSeek V4 Flash, DeepSeek V4 Pro, MiMo V2.5 Pro, Qwen 3.7 Plus, Kimi K3, Qwen 3.7 Max, and GLM 5.2.


- The text formatting menu now appears immediately when you release the mouse after selecting text.
- Fix an issue where some videos could play upside down.
- Fix an issue where the "Move to assigned date" preference for to-dos wasn't preserved after restarting the app.
- Fix an issue where navigating back could briefly show the wrong tab and break forward navigation.
- Fix an issue where the export all data feature failed to work.


## v1.99.0[​](https://wiki.heptabase.com/changelog/changelog#v1990)


*July 23, 2026*


- AI Agent: Organize Your Entire Knowledge Base with AI


- 中文版影片：用 AI 整理整個知識庫


- You can now open AI chats as tabs.
- You can now use skills in AI chat by typing / in the message composer.
- You can now set Space Instructions to customize how AI works in your space.
- You can now continue using the AI agent with basic models after your premium model quota is used up.
- Redesign the onboarding experience for new users.
- The right sidebar now preserves your complete panel navigation history.
- Fix an issue where incomplete mention syntax could briefly appear as raw text while AI responses were streaming.
- Fix an issue where tag navigation history wasn't preserved.
- Fix an issue where keyboard shortcuts could switch the sidebar to unsupported panels.


## Mobile app v1.37.3[​](https://wiki.heptabase.com/changelog/changelog#mobile-app-v1373)


*July 23, 2026*

*July 15, 2026*


- Support Claude 5 Sonnet, Claude 4.8 Opus, and GPT-5.6 (Luna / Terra / Sol) models in AI chat.
- You can now add general web links (not just YouTube links) as sources when researching a new topic.

- Improve whiteboard dragging performance.
- Fix an issue where the AI chat kept auto-scrolling to the bottom after you scrolled up during streaming.
- Fix table width jittering while AI responses were streaming.
- Fix arrow-key navigation moving into folded list content.
- Fix issues where multiple search dialogs could stay open, and Cmd+F in a web tab affected other panes.
- Fix web card titles being lost while previews were generating.
- Fix completed AI actions still showing a thinking indicator.
- Fix an issue where some YouTube videos couldn't be played when embedded in Heptabase.
- Fix an issue where pasting a code block copied from ChatGPT inserted an extra empty code block.

## v1.98.0[​](https://wiki.heptabase.com/changelog/changelog#v1980)


*June 2, 2026*

- AI Agent can edit property values on cards in a tag database (table cells), with snapshot-based undo like other edits.
- You can now copy tag database links to open a tag in Heptabase, or paste them as @mentions.
- Card menu: hide the "Open in new tab" shortcut when "Add here" is available, so shortcuts match the shown action.
- Fix Quick Find and template command palette not focusing the search field after opening or closing related dialogs.
